orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Lumen "Ion Drive: Zenith", a hull mount (outward is up): the 4x3 housing: four ion rings (widest at the nozzle) under a crystal emitter, tall crystal fins on both flanks, a ring of light round the base of the spine, and a floating ring of crystal glints in the glow above the nozzle; inside the Corona core with a second, dashed ring of light round the lens. Damaged: the second ring has slipped out of line and cracked, the emitter crystal is chipped, a fin is snapped half off, arcs jump the gap, the lens is cracked and flickers. Disabled: the top ring snapped half off and hanging, the emitter broken, both fin clusters dead and broken, the lens shattered. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
